constraints.name: customer_order_values_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((subtotal_cents >= 0) AND (item_count > 0) AND ((discount_cents >= 0) AND (discount_cents <= subtotal_cents)) AND (deposit_required_cents >= 0) AND (final_total_cents >= 0) AND (cancellation_total_cents >= 0) AND (revision >= 0) AND (fulfillment_type = 'PICKUP'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['CONFIRMED'::text, 'PAID'::text, 'COMPLETED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text])) AND (order_number ~ '^[2-9A-HJKMNP-Z]{6}$'::text) AND ((contact_phone_number IS NULL) OR (contact_phone_number ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{1,14}$'::text)) AND (((status = ANY (ARRAY['CONFIRMED'::text, 'PAID'::text])) AND (completed_at IS NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL) AND (cancellation_total_cents IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'COMPLETED'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_at IS NULL) AND (cancellation_total_cents IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) AND (cancellation_total_cents IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES customer_order(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: order_audit_values_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((actor_uid <> ''::text) AND (action <> ''::text) AND (order_revision >= 0) AND (jsonb_typeof(changes) = 'object'::text) AND (changes ? 'before'::text) AND (changes ? 'after'::text)))

routines.name: check_order_capacity_totals
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_order_capacity_totals()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE target uuid;
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='customer_order' THEN target:=NEW.id; ELSE target:=NEW.order_id; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_order WHERE id=target AND booking_managed) AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM
      (SELECT capacity_group_id AS group_id,sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM order_item
        WHERE order_id=target AND capacity_group_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY capacity_group_id) i
      FULL JOIN (SELECT group_id,sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM order_capacity_allocation WHERE order_id=target GROUP BY group_id) a USING(group_id)
      WHERE i.quantity IS DISTINCT FROM a.quantity
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'GROUP_ALLOCATION_INVALID'; END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_payment_correction_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.order_id
    OR NEW.method IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.method OR NEW.received_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.received_at
    OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at OR NEW.provider IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.provider
    OR NEW.provider_reference IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.provider_reference THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYMENT_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

routines.name: guard_product_capacity_group
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_product_capacity_group()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.capacity_group_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capacity_group WHERE id=NEW.capacity_group_id AND NOT archived)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'GROUP_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.capacity_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.capacity_group_id AND NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_CONFLICT'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lock_order_creation_sources(product_ids uuid[], client_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.product WHERE id=ANY(product_ids) ORDER BY id FOR SHARE;
  IF client_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.client WHERE id=client_id FOR SHARE;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_order_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.order_number IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.order_number
    OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order identity and creation time are immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_unallocated_group()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_order o JOIN product p ON p.id=NEW.product_id
    WHERE o.id=NEW.order_id AND NOT o.booking_managed AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PAID') AND p.capacity_group_id IS NOT NULL)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ALLOCATION_AWARE_CREATE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

routines.name: special_day_capacity
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.special_day_capacity(target uuid, pickup_day date)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT r.capacity_per_block FROM public.special_day_rule r
  WHERE r.group_id=target AND (extract(month FROM pickup_day)::integer*100+extract(day FROM pickup_day)::integer)=ANY(r.day_keys)
  ORDER BY r.saved_revision DESC LIMIT 1
$function$

routines.name: valid_special_day_keys
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.valid_special_day_keys(keys integer[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT array_ndims(keys)=1 AND cardinality(keys) BETWEEN 1 AND 366
    AND keys=ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT key FROM unnest(keys) key ORDER BY key)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(keys) key WHERE key IS NULL OR key NOT BETWEEN 101 AND 1231
      OR key%100 NOT BETWEEN 1 AND (ARRAY[31,29,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31])[key/100])
$function$
